title: A Day with Elvira
text: During our visit to Barcelona, we booked an all-day tour with Elvira to visit some of the areas outside the city.  She put together an itinerary that first took us to the coastal town of Sitges.  It was our good luck that the Festa Major, honoring Sitges' patron saint Sant Bartomeu, was underway.  We were able to watch processions and folk dances by participants in traditional costumes.  Sadly, we missed seeing the building of a castell (where “castellers” stand on top of one another to form a human tower). title: Well worth the money for the private experience!
text: We had an amazing trip with Elvira! Very knowledgeable, personal and caring. Great with engaging my 9 year old son who has ADHD. It was a beautiful day as we were a party of 8 who toured privately with her! The driver was wonderful too! Najeeb! Thank you!!
author: anncE9357WU

title: A Great Day Tour of Montserrat & Sitges provided by Go Local Barcelona
text: The day trip to Montserrat & Sitges was fantastic!  I highly recommend hiring Go Local Barcelona for this tour.  Elvira is very knowledgeable about both locations and provided tons of information to go along with the stunning vistas.  She went out of her way to ensure we enjoyed our day trip to the area surrounding Barcelona.  In addition, she spoke of several other day trips from Barcelona to other interesting towns in the region.  We will hire Go Local Barcelona & Elvira for additional day trips the next time we are in Spain.
